credits_text: STEVEN T. SHIPPY AND HAUNTED SAGINAW PRESENT
other_text: "NOT ONLY WERE WE TRYING TO SAVE A FAMILY FROM THE CLUTCHES OF A DARK AND MYSTERIOUS ENTITY, WE WERE TRYING TO RESCUE AN INNOCENT SPIRIT HAUNTED BY ANOTHER GHOST." — STEVEN T. SHIPPY, FOUNDER OF HAUNTED SAGINAW
description: Poster shows a dark building with two silhouetted figures in windows, titled 'A Haunting on Brockway Street' by Steven T. Shippy.
